title: iPhone held by iphone-runner, unused for 5 min while 4 jobs wait

messages.text:
iphone-runner has held the iPhone lease for 5 min without a phone run (iphone.mjs run, scroll, record or gesture; since 06:42Z, lease taken by iphone-runner). The limit is 5 min.
Queued for it: fix-rest-script, cd-roll-ca.
Waiting on the status board: cd-roll-ca (owner fix-cd-roll-ca; waits on the phone); hero-exit-threaded (owner fix-hero-exit-threaded; its note names the phone).
iphone-runner: run your phone part now, or release the lease (node tools/lock.mjs release iphone --owner iphone-runner) so the next one can start, or say here why it waits. Desk (mgmt-ops-10): please make sure the phone is used.
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the phone is used again or released (tools/idle.mjs, I-105, I-111).

The phone is not idle: it's waiting for you.

- The hero swipe test (step C-038) is loaded on the iPhone and ready.
- No phone run shows yet because the test starts when you press Start.
- The other jobs wait their turn after it (lead's order).

What you need to do: open "Your steps", press Start on C-038 and swipe as it says. If you'd rather do it later, say so here and the queued checks will go first.
